proposed_capability: MoonWake Closers P83→P03→P141→P124→P04: postmerge verify spatial advisor and repair false candidate targeting when a stale map and its calibration both remain internally consistent but the observed active lot or exact game build changes. Fail closed when active provenance is unknown; never equate a synthetic world map or unverified category with a game click. Existing PR159 perception writer is excluded.
player_save_control_impact: Only change pure read-only semantic planning, its existing room traverse adapter, fixture regressions, contract and reports. No scan of saves, no screenshots, focus/keyboard/mouse, EA asset copies, hooks, daemons, or game input.
expected_outcome: Require observed active lot/build at all call sites of the world-frame advisor; deny stale or absent world context and unsupported unknown target category; retain camera revision and map snapshot checks; verify green CI and mainline readback.
negative_tests: Stale map and matching old camera both refer to prior lot: active newer lot must abstain
Stale map and matching old camera both refer to prior exact game build: active newer build must abstain
Absent active world/build independently abstains; cannot use map-stored value as attestation
Unknown class cannot offer projected framing coordinates
Room traverse bridge passes active world identity to pure evaluator
Existing correct-floor calibrated and identity-verified object still yields non-executing framing candidate
rollback_path: Revert new scoped closer PR without modifying earlier #197; prior merged map/consultation and PR159 remain intact; no runtime state migrations.
unresolved_unknowns: PR159 still independent (open at preflight); do not overwrite its sensor/host files
No local Windows Sims P08 host evidence or real classifier/SLAM results
BI-002 hunger live certification remains separate and active
decision_rationale: P141 contrasted three theses: (a) install broad dense image SLAM now (REJECTED: no physical depth/IMU evidence), (b) merge open PR159 sensor immediately (DEFERRED: independent writer and no local P08), (c) harden existing camera-map advisor's external current-world attestation (SURVIVES: reproducible stale-map path); selected (c). P124 reuses existing owner, P04 separates cloud CI from blocked local screen owner.
